description: This file defines a test class 'TestMultiCollectionGrain' implementing various collection operations (dictionary, list, queue, set) for testing purposes within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for adding, removing, retrieving, and counting items in these collections, as well as retrieving an activation ID.

classes.name: TestMultiCollectionGrain
classes.description: A test grain class implementing collection operations for dictionary, list, queue, and set, used in Orleans testing scenarios.

methods.name: AddToDictionary
methods.description: Adds or updates a key-value pair in the dictionary and writes the state asynchronously.

methods.name: RemoveFromDictionary
methods.description: Removes a key from the dictionary and writes the state asynchronously.

methods.name: GetDictionaryValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key from the dictionary.

methods.name: GetDictionaryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the dictionary.

methods.name: AddToList
methods.description: Adds an item to the list and writes the state asynchronously.

methods.name: RemoveListItemAt
methods.description: Removes an item at a specified index from the list and writes the state asynchronously.

methods.name: GetListItem
methods.description: Retrieves an item at a specified index from the list.

methods.name: GetListCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the list.

methods.name: AddToQueue
methods.description: Enqueues an item into the queue and writes the state asynchronously.

methods.name: DequeueItem
methods.description: Dequeues an item from the queue.

methods.name: PeekQueueItem
methods.description: Returns the item at the front of the queue without removing it.

methods.name: GetQueueCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the queue.

methods.name: AddToSet
methods.description: Adds an item to the set and writes the state asynchronously.

methods.name: RemoveFromSet
methods.description: Removes an item from the set.

methods.name: ContainsSetItem
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in the set.

methods.name: GetSetCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the set.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Returns the activation ID of the grain.
